basic_info.description: Just north of Cortland's village, this 2 lvl 3BDR /2.5BA home w family room is a rare find! The light-filled living room lined w windows and built-in cabinetry, flows to a skylit kitchen and dining area w Fleetwood glass doors opening to a sunny deck. The custom kitchen boasts stone counters, sleek cabinetry, a Thermador appliance suite - 6-burner range, wine column, refrigerator, and dishwasher - and is anchored by a 4-seat waterfall island. The dining area, warmed by a gas fireplace and punctuated by built-ins, opens seamlessly to the deck and garden. 2 serene BDRs and a skylit full BA with Hansgrohe fixtures and Toto wall-hung toilet complete the main level. Downstairs, the spacious family room opens to the patio and garden. The luxe primary suite offers custom closets, abundant windows, and a spa-like bath w soaking tub, rain shower, and a double vanity. Outside the west facing deck and patio spaces are lined w lush plantings, lemon trees and herbs. Renovated as the owners' primary residence in 2023 w new systems, windows, insulation, sewer lateral, + structural upgrades. Wide-plank oak floors and Bowers & Wilkins speakers throughout. Lg garage w Tesla charger, laundry, and storage. 93 WalkScore, steps to shops, cafes, Bernal Hill, tech shuttles, and easy 280/101 access. WOW!
